{{Quote|So you wanna hurry up with unloading those weapons an' power packs?|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 9">[[Star Wars (1977) 9|''Star Wars'' (1977) 9]]</ref>}}
'''Power cells''' (also called '''power packs''' or '''power paks''') provided energy for many vehicles, and even small and/or large [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons and tools.

==Description==
[[File:PowerCell-Chewbacca2.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Chewbacca holding a small power cell.]]
Most power cells contained concentrated amounts of gases that, when heated, formed plasma. In small blasters, power cells were used to create blaster bolts that were not nearly as powerful as blasters using a combination of magazines containing gases (that after being heated would change into plasma) and proper [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster power packs]]. Power cells were flammable.<ref name="Boba Fett ½">[[Boba Fett ½|''Boba Fett'' ½]]</ref>

Particle power packs, used in the weapons by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], released unstable particles through an electrical exciter coil and were shot out the barrel. [[Sturm dowel/Legends|Sturm dowels]] were components.

A small power cell could power a [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthesis]] without the need for recharging.

The [[Telgorn Corporation/Legends|Telgorn Corporation]] produced power cells.

Certain creatures, such as the [[Oblee|shadow lurkers]], fed on the energy of power cells, rendering the devices useless.<ref name="MW">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: MidWorld}}</ref>

Power packs were used in starships' [[Cooling unit/Legends|cooling units]].<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>
